subject: On-prem / air-gapped deployment qualification - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Thompson <alan.thompson@legacybank.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem / air-gapped deployment qualification - next steps

Hi Alan —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the on‑prem / air‑gapped qualification for LegacyBank: 

Summary from call:
- LegacyBank is evaluating Redwood Private (air‑gapped) for models used in transaction fraud detection and internal document ingestion.
- Primary blockers: hardware maintenance/upgrades in an offline environment, secure bootstrapping for the appliance, and procurement lead times for GPUs.
- Expected initial footprint: 4 racks (pilot) with potential to scale to 12 racks within 12 months depending on performance.

Technical open items we agreed to validate:
1) Hardware compatibility + exact GPU models you can accommodate (we discussed A800 vs H100 footprints).
2) Maintenance/upgrade process when systems are offline — who performs hardware swaps, how we handle kernel/firmware updates in an air‑gapped environment.
3) Network & ops: traceroute/egress requirements for periodic license checks (if any) and out‑of‑band support channels.
4) Backup/restore and KV cache persistence expectations for the inference runtime.

Next steps (proposed):
- I will share our on‑prem requirements doc and a small network diagram (attached) by EOD.
- Dev, can you take a pass on a short note describing our recommended hardware SKUs + a suggested offline upgrade playbook?
- Alan, if you can share the procurement timeline and point person, we’ll draft a mutual action plan.

Proposed timeline: pilot config and SOW draft in 2 weeks, on‑site (or on‑prem engineer visit) scheduled for late May.

Thanks —
Marissa
VP, Strategic Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_onprem_requirements_v2.pdf (specs summary), network_diagram_stub.png

From: Alan Thompson <alan.thompson@legacybank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: LegacyBank Procurement <procurement@legacybank.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2028 08:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: On-prem / air-gapped deployment qualification - next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with infra and procurement: 

1) Hardware: we can support H100s in our current procurement cycle but lead times are 10–12 weeks. A800s are available faster (3–4 weeks) but we need to confirm performance tradeoffs for your workload.
2) Maintenance: bank policy requires that hardware swaps in air‑gapped data centers be performed by approved partners or in‑house engineers; our ops team cannot accept remote hands from vendors unless they go through a third‑party attestation process.
3) Network: we cannot allow outbound license checks. Any license or heartbeat must be handled via an approved relay hosted inside our network.
4) Backup: we can accept offline snapshot backups to a physically separate storage array with encrypted transfer during maintenance windows.

Procurement contact: procurement@legacybank.com — they will start an RFx for the rack and cabling once we land on SKUs.

Question for Dev: can Redwood produce a short offline patch/upgrade playbook that avoids outbound calls and can be executed by our engineers or an approved partner? Also if you can include an expected downtime window for kernel/firmware updates, that’ll help with our change control.

Thanks,
Alan
Director, Infrastructure Architecture
LegacyBank

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alan Thompson <alan.thompson@legacybank.com>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem / air-gapped deployment qualification - next steps

Alan / Marissa —

Thanks — quick technical note on hardware and the offline upgrade playbook (high level):

Hardware recommendations (pilot - 4 racks):
- Controller nodes: 2x per rack, 2x Intel Xeon Gold equivalent, 256GB RAM, 2x 10GbE management NICs.
- Inference nodes: 4x H100 (if you can accept lead time) or 6x A800 per rack to match target throughput.
- Storage: NVMe tier for KV cache + separate encrypted HDD array for offline snapshots.

Offline upgrade/maintenance playbook (summary):
- Preparation: Redwood provides a signed upgrade bundle (image + checksums) and a USB package for air‑gapped transfer.
- Validation: On your side, an approved engineer verifies checksums and signs an approval token (we can provide a template). No outbound connections required.
- Execution: Physical media applied by your engineer/approved partner during scheduled maintenance window. We provide step‑by‑step runbook and a fallback rollback image.
- Support: Remote support channel will be asynchronous; we can use an encrypted, bank‑hosted SFTP for logs and a ticketed workflow for escalation.

Downtime estimates: minor runtime patches—rolling restarts across nodes (minimal impact if stateful KV is replicated); major kernel/firmware updates—up to 2–4 hours per rack depending on firmware.

I’ll draft a 1‑page playbook and an asset checklist for the procurement RFx. Marissa — attaching that draft to the SOW package will help.

—Dev
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Thompson <alan.thompson@legacybank.com>, Procurement <procurement@legacybank.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2028 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem / air-gapped deployment qualification - next steps

Perfect — this is exactly the level of detail we need. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) I’m attaching the on‑prem requirements doc and a stub network diagram. Please review with your infra and procurement teams.
2) Dev will finalize the 1‑page offline upgrade playbook and an RFx checklist by Wednesday EOD PT.
3) Marissa action: I’ll create a draft mutual action plan in HubSpot and share a DocuSign SOW template for initial review. Link to deal (HubSpot): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7891 (internal).

Alan — can procurement confirm target approval date for the RFx? If we can align on SKUs this week, we can hit the pilot SOW draft target in two weeks.

Thanks all —
Marissa
